response.sql: WITH signed_trans AS (SELECT account_id, CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END as signed_amount FROM trans WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')), account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(signed_amount) as avg_amount FROM signed_trans GROUP BY account_id), mean_of_averages AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_mean FROM account_averages) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.avg_amount, aa.avg_amount - ma.overall_mean as difference FROM account_averages aa CROSS JOIN mean_of_averages ma WHERE aa.avg_amount > ma.overall_mean ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
